_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); discount-retail signals

pit_profile.why: Walmart: 'operates retail stores in various formats around the world and is committed to saving people money so they can live better'; 'every day low prices (“EDLP”)'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' (its Walmart U.S. segment competes with discount, department, drug, variety and specialty stores, supermarkets, supercenter-type stores and hypermarts, 'as well as internet-based retailers and catalog businesses'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2010 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Walmart: 'operates retail stores in various formats around the world and is committed to saving people money so they can live better'; 'every day low prices (“EDLP”)'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' (its Walmart U.S. segment competes with discount, department, drug, variety and specialty stores, supermarkets, supercenter-type stores and hypermarts, 'as well as internet-based retailers and catalog businesses'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2010 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B -0.04x; -13% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.29; conservative 2yr +40%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY01-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +3.6%/yr (Q2 ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.9%/yr (FY01-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +17.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY01-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: WMT (retrospective, 2010-09-10) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.04x (-5.8% downside to Bear $55 / +159.8% upside to Bull $135) | Adj composite 1.65 vs market 1.36: gap +0.29 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | -13% above the EPP floor $60 (15x FY11E $4.00) | Conservative 2-yr case: +39.9% total (+20.0%/yr) | At 13.0x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $69 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. comps -1.1% in Q2 FY11, forward sales +2% (no FY11 net sales guide in numbers, Q2 FY11 net sales at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
